newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-FINAL DAY SNIPPETS FROM THE FRENCH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-FINAL DAY SNIPPETS FROM THE FRENCH OPEN.

text.p: A brief selection of highlights from the final day of the French Open on Sunday:

Best Quote - "I have everything I need, I have a good house and I have my mum's car I can drive a little bit." Gustavo Kuerten when asked how he might spend some of the $695,000 he received for winning the French Open.

Stat of the day - 81 - The number of drug tests conducted at the French Open. During the first week, players were selected at random while all singles players advancing to the round of 16 and beyond plus all doubles players from the quarter-finals onwards were tested.

Black mark - With brothers Byron and Wayne Black knocked out in the opening two rounds of the tournament by Chile's Marcelo Rios, it was up to younger sister Cara to uphold the family honour. Cara returned home to Zimbabwe with the junior doubles title she won with Kazakhstan's Irina Seljutina and almost had to make room in her suitcase for the singles crown as well, losing 4-6 6-4 6-4 to Belgium's Justine Henin in the final on Sunday.
